scoring_justification: Full recompute of the diameters from the nucleation equations is infeasible inside the verifier; the primary claim is a relative ordering, which is verifiable as a structural check.

outputs.description: Critical cluster diameters from the classical IIN theory and the present dipole-charge corrected model. The checker validates that both are positive and assesses the physical consistency of the values.

output_contract.notes: Only structural validity and physical consistency are scored; exact numerical agreement with the paper is not required.
